note: G104: the no-rules prior on the loop's own split, recomputed through the evaluator's composition.

controls.name: C1_split_does_not_leak
controls.must_fire_because: the null must be measured on the same leak-free split as the metric it bounds, or it is not its null

controls.name: C2_both_halves_of_every_query_are_scored
controls.must_fire_because: a null scored on tail queries only would be half a measurement compared against a full one

controls.name: C3_ties_are_not_scored_at_their_best_position
controls.must_fire_because: a prior that abstains ties on most of the entity set; ranking a tie at its top turns abstention into skill
controls.can_fail_because: a target with count 0 receives rank 1
controls.null_must_contain: the rank of a zero-count target

controls.name: C4_mrr_cannot_exceed_its_hits10_bound
controls.must_fire_because: MRR is a mean of 1/rank. A fraction Hits@10 of queries rank 1 at best; the rest rank 11 at worst. Exceeding h + (1-h)/11 is not a surprising result but an arithmetic impossibility
controls.can_fail_because: a rank function that returns a rank below 1

controls.name: C5_an_untied_winner_is_rank_1
controls.must_fire_because: the first version returned 0.5 here and nothing else in the run could see it
controls.can_fail_because: the tied-block midpoint is computed off by one

falsifiers.name: F1_null_does_not_reproduce_through_this_path
falsifiers.refutes: that G49's null and the evaluator's split are the same object
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_the_system_is_not_below_its_null
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both numbers and the signed gap
falsifiers.refutes: the whole row; the status string would be fine
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: the null does not reproduce through the evaluator's own composition, OR the system is not in fact below it
